# A wildcard stands for names in one position, and says which names stand
# there. Three things follow, each of which the compiler used to get wrong.

# 1. A spread field is a written prop name like any other, so one a wildcard
# prop covers is collected into that prop rather than becoming an argument
# named after a prop no component declares. As a bare argument it named
# nothing and every backend dropped it.
sngl dump --stage checked --lang none --platform html spread.sngl
stdout 'td\(attrs=\{"bgcolor" = '
! stdout 'td\(bgcolor='

# 2. An HTML tag name is lowercase, so a camelCase identifier inside a
# `platform html { ... }` body — where a bare name reaches the element
# wildcard — is a misspelling rather than a tag nobody has standardised yet.
! sngl dump --stage checked --lang none --platform html typo.sngl
stderr 'unknown component "thisIsATypoNotATag"'

# 3. A dot import lifts a package's declarations. A wildcard component's
# declaration is its own name; the open set of names it also answers to
# belongs to the package, and is reached by naming it (`html.div`) or from
# inside its platform's body. Lifted, it left the importing file with no
# undeclared node name to misspell and no undefined identifier at all. The
# name below is a real tag, so only the lift can make it resolve here.
! sngl dump --stage checked --lang none --platform html dotimport.sngl
stderr 'unknown component "div"'

# The declaration itself is lifted, and is how the open set is reached from a
# file that dot-imported the package.
sngl dump --stage checked --lang none --platform html dotdecl.sngl
stdout 'element\(tag="div"\)'

! sngl dump --stage checked --lang none --platform html dotexpr.sngl
stderr 'undefined: someUndefinedIdentifier'

-- spread.sngl --
import std "sngl://std"
import html "sngl://platforms/html"

struct tdAttrs {
    bgcolor string
    colspan string
}

component main() {
    std.window {
        platform html {
            html.td(...tdAttrs{bgcolor = "lime", colspan = "2"}) { }
        }
    }
}
-- typo.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

component main() {
    window {
        platform html {
            thisIsATypoNotATag(id = "x") { }
        }
    }
}
-- dotimport.sngl --
import std "sngl://std"
import . "sngl://platforms/html"

component main() {
    std.window {
        div(id = "x") { }
    }
}
-- dotexpr.sngl --
import std "sngl://std"
import . "sngl://platforms/html"

func typoed() => someUndefinedIdentifier

component main() {
    std.window {
        std.text(value = "x")
    }
}
-- dotdecl.sngl --
import std "sngl://std"
import . "sngl://platforms/html"

component main() {
    std.window {
        element(tag = "div") { }
    }
}
